scope: Additional established parent aroma chemicals for pharmacology/toxicology literature discovery only.

chemicals.name: beta-caryophyllene
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2252 identifies this flavor ingredient and gives a spice/wood flavor profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from alpha-caryophyllene (humulene) and caryophyllene oxide. Generic caryophyllene needs identity confirmation rather than automatic broad matching.

chemicals.name: alpha-humulene
chemicals.membership_evidence: The individual NHPID chemical record explicitly lists a non-medicinal flavour-enhancer purpose.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Alpha-caryophyllene is a synonym of humulene, not beta-caryophyllene; one identity.

chemicals.name: beta-myrcene
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2762 identifies this flavor ingredient and provides balsamic, fruit, geranium and herb profile terms.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.regulatory_note: FEMA record notes synthetic myrcene is not permitted for addition to US food after October 9, 2020. Aroma membership does not imply current food authorization.

chemicals.name: alpha-bisabolol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA individual alpha-bisabolol record explicitly records flavoring use and FEMA 4666.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: FEMA lists (±)-alpha-bisabolol with CAS 23089-26-1 and 515-69-5; FDA CAS is retained verbatim. Do not merge beta-bisabolol, epi-isomers, or assume enantiomer-specific results are equivalent. Generic bisabolol requires alpha identity confirmation.

chemicals.name: isoborneol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA explicitly records flavoring use; FEMA 2158 gives a camphor/must profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Exo-borneol, distinct from borneol. FDA food record is relative/racemic CAS 124-76-5; (-)-isoborneol has a separate absolute stereochemical FDA record and CAS 10334-13-1. Preserve study stereochemistry.

chemicals.name: d-fenchone
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2479 identifies d-fenchone and a mint/cool profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Keep distinct from l-fenchone. Generic fenchone title requires identity resolution; it is not a third discrete identity.

chemicals.name: l-fenchone
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 4519 identifies l-fenchone with a floral profile; JECFA record also describes camphor/herbal/woody aroma.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Keep distinct from d-fenchone. Do not equate isofenchone with fenchone.

chemicals.name: fenchol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.verified_use: flavor enhancer; flavoring agent or adjuvant
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA lists fenchol as a synonym of fenchyl alcohol with explicit flavor roles; FEMA 2480 gives camphor/lemon profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Use CAS and study stereochemistry; do not collapse every fenchol stereoisomer or substitute fenchone.

chemicals.name: estragole
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; fragrance ingredient
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA records explicit flavoring use; PubChem carries NTP anise odor and IFRA fragrance identity.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.regulatory_note: FEMA GRAS 31 (2024), pp. 50-51, removes estragole added as such from FEMA GRAS pending additional data. Include as established parent aroma chemical, never present as currently FEMA GRAS.

chemicals.name: methyl eugenol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food; US NTP
chemicals.membership_evidence: NTP TR-491 explicitly documents parent use as both flavor and fragrance; FDA provides the identity and no-longer-FEMA-GRAS status.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.regulatory_note: FDA record says NLFG-2475; no longer FEMA GRAS (GRAS 28, 2018). Historical aroma membership is not current authorization.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from isoeugenyl methyl ether / methyl isoeugenol and eugenol.

chemicals.name: cuminaldehyde
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2341 identifies the parent and a green/herbal/sharp profile; FEMA GRAS 3 supplies short parent synonyms.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.

chemicals.name: methyl anthranilate
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.verified_use: flavoring agent or adjuvant; also solvent or vehicle
chemicals.membership_evidence: FDA records explicit flavoring role; FEMA 2682 describes flower/honey/peach profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Exclude solvent-only use. Do not transfer membership to anthranilate derivative libraries or N-methylanthranilate.

chemicals.name: benzyl salicylate
chemicals.source_authority: FEMA Flavor Ingredient Library; US FDA
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2151 gives a honey profile; FDA Allergens in Cosmetics explicitly lists benzyl salicylate among fragrance ingredients.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Only this unchanged parent; not generic salicylate chemistry.

chemicals.name: alpha-santalol
chemicals.source_authority: US FDA Substances Added to Food
chemicals.membership_evidence: Individual FDA alpha-santalol record explicitly records flavoring use and identity.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Generic santalol CAS 11031-45-1 is an alpha/beta mixture (PubChem reference collection). Do not map it automatically to alpha-santalol; beta-santalol is distinct and not independently verified in this file.

chemicals.name: safrole
chemicals.source_authority: US NTP Report on Carcinogens, 15th edition
chemicals.membership_evidence: NTP gives sassafras odor and documents historical flavoring of drugs and use in perfumes/soaps.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.regulatory_note: NTP explicitly states direct food addition/use as human food is prohibited in the US. Historical odorant membership only; no safety or authorization inference.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from isosafrole and piperonyl butoxide; derivatives and manufacturing-only papers are not eligible.

chemicals.name: p-cymene
chemicals.membership_evidence: FEMA 2356 identifies p-cymene and a fresh/citrus flavor profile.
chemicals.eligibility: Unchanged parent centrally administered, assayed or mechanistically studied; exclude derivatives, scaffold libraries, extracts-only and solvent-only papers.
chemicals.identity_note: Distinct from o-cymene, m-cymene and p-cymen-8-ol. Exclude solvent-only papers.

unresolved_or_nonqualifying_identity_ter.reason: Generic name can be ambiguous; match beta identity only with evidence, never humulene or oxide by substring.
Unspecified enantiomer; d and l entries are documented independently. A paper may be screened but cannot be assigned to one enantiomer by name alone.
Generic alpha/beta mixture is not a discrete identity; alpha entry verified separately. Do not count generic and alpha as additional molecules.
Not independently source-verified for flavor/fragrance membership in this pass; no automatic addition.

notes: This new file supplements existing allowlists; it is not a cumulative replacement.
16 verified entries represent the requested 15 labels with d/l-fenchone split and generic santalol restricted to alpha-santalol.
Identity, flavor/fragrance membership, present authorization, and paper relevance are different assertions.
Keep exact parent matching, central pharmacology/toxicology evidence and derivative/extract/solvent exclusions. Never count candidates as accepted studies or widen to meet numerical targets.
